CustomField.description: Returns a color image based on the status of the Transcript Status field. Field will be added to highlights panel of the Educational History lightning page.
CustomField.formula:
/*Returns a color image based on the status of the Transcript Status field. Field will be added to highlights panel of the Educational History lightning page.*/
CASE(Transcript_Status__c, 'Not Yet Received', IMAGE("/img/samples/color_yellow.gif", '',50,50), 'Compliant',IMAGE("/img/samples/color_green.gif", '',50,50), 'Non-Compliant',IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", '',50,50), '')
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When yellow, this student’s nursing background check has not yet been approved. When it is green, it has been approved. When red, the background check has failed.
CustomField.label: Background Status
